verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (logo, headline, three cans with paired names and descriptors, body line, CTA) and it all reads cleanly. But it is the 614px layout spread across a wider canvas, not a real rearrangement: the cans spread wide with loose gutters, the headline is undersized for the square, and about 140px of empty space sits under the CTA. B is broken. The CTA has moved to the top-left, competing with the logo. The three flavour names are stacked in reverse order and cut off from their descriptors, which are listed separately, out of order, below the body copy. That body copy is cramped right under the names. One big can stands in for three, and two tiny leftover cans sit stranded in the bottom-left corner.
